title: releaseFiles
responsibility: Builds a pinned source revision in Docker and verifies the stored artifact against its release identity and SHA-256 before promotion.

inputs.name: buildRelease.store
inputs.description: Owner-only deployment state directory and its artifact index.

inputs.name: buildRelease.config
inputs.description: Reviewed project or target settings for this operation.

inputs.name: buildRelease.spec
inputs.description: Project identity, pinned source revision and reviewed manifest digest.

inputs.name: verifyArtifact.store
inputs.description: Owner-only deployment state directory and its artifact index.

inputs.name: verifyArtifact.value
inputs.description: Immutable release manifest with the artifact size, expected digest and release ID.

outputs.name: buildRelease
outputs.description: The sealed release manifest and digest of the archived Docker build output.

outputs.name: verifyArtifact
outputs.description: The path of the stored artifact after its manifest, length and SHA-256 have been verified.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The operation could not verify its input, target identity, or expected result.
